candidateOccurrences.sourceText: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.
